name: comms_sdk

routes._comment: The installed page carries @RoutePage() with the NotificationListPage class name, so auto_route generates NotificationListRoute in the host's own app_router.gr.dart. Path and route name match paas_manager's existing hand-written CupertinoRoute(path: '/list-notification', page: NotificationListRoute.page), so the composed restaurant tab's context.pushRoute(const NotificationListRoute()) keeps working when the host deletes its own copy of the page and drops the hand-written route.

_comment_embedded_widgets: languageScreen: comms_sdk owns the language surface (LanguageScreen in src/common/presentation/pages/setting/language_page.dart, signature-matched to base_sdk's EmbeddedWidgets.languageScreen({required VoidCallback onSave})). Until now NO SDK declared it - supacharge's legacy hand-edited main covered it - so auth_sdk's login language switcher threw a StateError in any fully generated compose. Declared at the manifest top level: every composed app with comms_sdk gets it.
_comment_app_type: manager: the host notification vertical becomes comms_sdk-owned (fork plan S-3, manager migration bucket b, D4 minimal parameterization). The application slice installs to lib/application/notification/ - the EXACT path paas_manager's tracked copies occupy, so the installer's hash guard warn-skips it until the manager repo deletes its host copies (migration stage M2), then compose provides it; notification_state.freezed.dart regenerates via the host's own build_runner pass. The page installs to the comms-owned lib/presentation/pages/notification/ path (no collision with the tracked host copy at pages/restaurant/, so it installs cleanly TODAY) and declares the /list-notification route; the class name keeps NotificationListPage so the route class regenerates identically. The page imports orders_sdk's installed order_details_modal.dart via ${package} (host-composition file - ADR-005-legal cross-SDK composition in host lib/) and orders_sdk's manager OrderData directly, so it only compiles in a manager compose alongside orders_sdk's app_type.manager installs - same contract as merchants_sdk's shell templates. Version bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 so version-aware cache reconciliation re-extracts composed copies. Follow-up (not here): comms declares the Firebase/FCM boot via the new boot_hooks manifest key once The-Rokct-Protocol#160 lands.
